notes: Single source of truth mapping paper-displayed models to reports/dev run directories.
Replaces the divergent PILOTS/PAPER_PILOTS lists formerly hand-maintained separately
role: 'field' = eligible for the comparative leaderboard/pairwise table/cost frontier,
subject to the completeness+rejection-rate eligibility rule in cross_field.py's eligible().
'effort-appendix' = same weights, different reasoning-effort setting, reported only in
the effort-sensitivity analysis, never in the field.
'route-appendix' = same weights/effort via a different serving route, reported only as a
route-sensitivity note, never in the field.
'missing' = expected but not yet present; validate_manifest.py checks this against disk.
'unrecoverable' = run in an earlier version, but no raw traces or per-run reports survive;
excluded from every table, figure and roster count, and disclosed as a limitation.
